components.usageRules: Use for status indicators, counts (number mode), category tags, and compact icon chips (icon-only mode). Don't use for filter pills (use Tabs variant=pills) or interactive elements (use Button). 8 variants: default, secondary, outline, destructive, ai, success, info, warning. No dot or destructive-subtle — those were dropped to match Figma.
